newsitem.title: USA: Banyan Strategic Realty sees '97 FFO up.
newsitem.headline: Banyan Strategic Realty sees '97 FFO up.

text.p: Banyan Strategic Realty Trust said Monday it expects funds from operations of about $0.50 to $0.55 in 1997, compared with $0.34 a share in 1996.
Banyan said it is targetting $0.65 to $0.70 a share FFO in 1998.

"Due to substantially higher streams of revenue from recent acquisitions and the strong average occupancy of our portfolio of properties, we anticipate FFO of anywhere from $0.50 per share in 1997 to $0.55," said Leonard Levine, president and chief executive officer of the trust.

Earlier, Banyan reported a 1996 net loss of $0.17 a share versus a profit of $0.25 a share in 1995. The loss was the result of a substantial write-down of the trust's 53 percent interest in the H-Street Venture, the company said. Banyan reported a loss of $3.3 million in real estate ventures from 1996 versus income of $472,003 in 1995.
Banyan said its average occupancy as a percent of gross leasable square footage was 93 percent for 1996 versus 91 percent in 1995.
